body: Reaction chip overlaps the timestamp because both are anchored to the bubble BOTTOM. ChatListCell.layoutSubviews inline-meta arm (ios/ChatModule/ChatListViewCells.swift:12754) puts metaContainerView at bubbleFrame.maxY - 5 - bubbleMetaHeight; reactionBadgeFrame (:16315) puts the strip at bubbleFrame.minX + 8, bubbleFrame.maxY - 6 - height. measureMessageBubbleLayout DOES grow bubbleHeight by reactionStripHeightOffset (:5692,:5702) but contentWidth (:5671) is only max(desiredContentWidth, reactionSize.width) — it never reserves reactionSize.width + reactionChipGap + meta.total. On a narrow bubble ('As') meta spans [maxY-19,maxY-5] and the strip [maxY-30,maxY-6]: they collide vertically AND horizontally. The bottom-meta arm (:12712, RTL column / rich text / link preview) does not collide — meta sits a line above the strip there.
